name: Inflearn
description:
Inflearn MCP connects Claude to your Inflearn course library so you can learn, review, and get help using the exact content from lectures you're enrolled in.

Ask questions in natural language and Claude searches across VOD lecture transcripts to find the right moment in the right course, then pulls the full lecture content, curriculum, or your learning history to answer with grounded, course-specific context.

Tools
• Search lectures: semantic vector search over VOD subtitle content; find concepts, code, or an instructor's explanation by
meaning, not keywords
• Get lecture content: retrieve the full text of a specific lecture unit
• Get curriculum: see a course's full structure (sections and units)
• List recent learnings: your recently watched lectures with progress
• List my courses: the full catalog of courses you have access to

Learning modes (prompts)
• Learn with instructor: 1:1 tutoring that adopts the instructor's persona
• Concept deep dive: motivation, principles, code walkthrough, comprehension check
• Quiz me: quizzes generated from real lecture content
• Study roadmap: a phased learning plan built from available lectures

Access & privacy
• Sign in with your Inflearn account via OAuth
• Access is limited to courses you're enrolled in
• All tools are read-only; the connector never modifies your account or data

_published_faq.name: How do I add Inflearn to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Inflearn to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.inflearn.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Inflearn MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Inflearn provides these MCP tools: get_curriculum, get_lecture_content, list_my_courses, list_my_recent_learnings, and search_lectures.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Inflearn?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Inflearn in education on the Manufact MCP catalog include DocCheck Flexikon, Vocaneo, Grammaropolis, TheWholeTorah, and Fryd - Your Gardening Companion.
Inflearn requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Inflearn is developed by Inflearn. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
